title: PreCompact output
description: Enriches the compaction; never prevents it. `decision: "block"` and exit code 2 are accepted for compatibility, logged and ignored. Top level open for Claude Code compatibility (same reason as hookSpecificOutput): unknown fields are ignored.

decision.description: Claude Code field (sources/claude-code-2026-10-30.md:3295). Only value: "block". Accepted, ignored in Zed (a hook never prevents compaction).

reason.description: Claude Code field (sources/claude-code-2026-10-30.md:3295). Logged by Zed.

hookSpecificOutput.description: Event-specific output. Open for Claude Code compatibility: Claude Code adds fields here across versions, and a script shared with Claude Code must not be rejected by Zed for a field Zed does not know. Unknown fields are ignored.

hookEventName.description: Claude Code field (sources/claude-code-2026-10-30.md:1064). Must be this event name; in Zed a mismatch is a hook failure.

zed.description: Zed extension. Instructions appended to the summary request.

additional_instructions.description: Text appended to the compaction instruction (for example: keep the plan path, the current skill, open questions).
